# Campus Livre

> Campus Livre is an initiative for free, open-source academic and scientific software, made in Brazil, built around digital sovereignty: knowledge tools should not sit behind paywalls or depend on a single country's commercial vendors. Its first product is MatLivre. Every page exists in English and in Brazilian Portuguese (same path under /pt/).

## MatLivre

- [MatLivre](https://campuslivre.github.io/matlivre/): free, MIT-licensed, MATLAB R2023b-compatible live script (.mlx) and script (.m) editor and runtime for Windows, written in Rust. Faster than MATLAB, GNU Octave and Scilab on the project's language benchmarks (4.7x, 72x and 71x on the geometric mean of 12 cases; behind in dense linear solves). Includes comparison with MATLAB and Octave, install instructions and known limits.
- [Wiki home](https://campuslivre.github.io/matlivre/wiki/): guide and function reference.
- [All functions](https://campuslivre.github.io/matlivre/wiki/functions/): every MATLAB and Symbolic Math Toolbox function MatLivre implements, each with its own page (summary, syntax, inputs, outputs, how it works, tested example with real output, known differences from MATLAB).
- [Guide: getting started](https://campuslivre.github.io/matlivre/wiki/start/), [live scripts](https://campuslivre.github.io/matlivre/wiki/live-scripts/), [keyboard shortcuts](https://campuslivre.github.io/matlivre/wiki/shortcuts/), [the language](https://campuslivre.github.io/matlivre/wiki/language/), [known limits](https://campuslivre.github.io/matlivre/wiki/limits/).
- Source code and issues: https://github.com/campuslivre/matlivre
